question_uz: 8 ta detalning 3 tasi yaroqsiz. Tasodifan 3 ta detal olinadi. Ulardan roppa-rosa bittasi yaroqsiz bo‘lish ehtimolini toping.
question_en: Among 8 parts, 3 are defective. Three parts are taken at random. Find the probability that exactly one of them is defective.
hint: 💡 Maslahat: P(A) = m / n (qulay natijalar / barcha natijalar). Qarama-qarshi hodisa P(not A) = 1 - P(A).
why_right: To'g'ri javob: «15/28». Umumiy formula: P = {CM^m C_{N-M}^{n-m}}{CNⁿ}. Qo‘yamiz: P = (C₃¹ C₅² / C₈³) = (3 * 10 / 56) = (15 / 28).
why_right_en: Correct answer: «15/28». General formula: P = {CM^m C_{N-M}^{n-m}}{CNⁿ}. Substituting: P = (C₃¹ C₅² / C₈³) = (3 * 10 / 56) = (15 / 28).
